ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to systematically discover and reproduce critical bugs on Mozark's real-device testing platform.
ideas.problem_statement: AI can build an app in minutes. Proving it works is the real skill: take a real app, test it, fix what breaks, and prove it performs on Mozark's platform on real devices.
ideas.title: Mozark MCP BugHunter Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets Mozark's core scoring rubric by automating the detection of reproducible user-journey failures that pass the 2-of-3 run consistency test.

ideas.pitch: A telemetry pipeline designed for Mozark's Infra starter org to monitor latency bottlenecks and infrastructural drop-offs during real-device execution.
ideas.problem_statement: AI can build an app in minutes. Proving it works is the real skill: take a real app, test it, fix what breaks, and prove it performs on Mozark's platform on real devices.
ideas.title: InfraTrace Performance Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Earns points on evidence rather than activity by producing rigorous performance profiling and telemetry reports directly consumable by Mozark admins.

ideas.pitch: Test Case Management (TCM) suite extension that automatically maps AI-generated user journeys to real-device execution traces on Mozark.
ideas.problem_statement: AI can build an app in minutes. Proving it works is the real skill: take a real app, test it, fix what breaks, and prove it performs on Mozark's platform on real devices.
ideas.title: TCM Journey Guardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on breaking key user journeys consistently, aligning with the strict bug-validation rules defined in the challenge guidelines.

ideas.pitch: A CLI and web dashboard that verifies and packages test logs, device screenshots, and failure evidence to maximize scoring on the 100-point scale.
ideas.problem_statement: AI can build an app in minutes. Proving it works is the real skill: take a real app, test it, fix what breaks, and prove it performs on Mozark's platform on real devices.
ideas.title: Mozark Evidence Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific rule that every point is earned on evidence, giving judges undeniable proof of reproducible bugs.

ideas.pitch: An agentic feedback loop that takes failed real-device test runs from Mozark, diagnoses the root cause, and generates clean code patches.
ideas.problem_statement: AI can build an app in minutes. Proving it works is the real skill: take a real app, test it, fix what breaks, and prove it performs on Mozark's platform on real devices.
ideas.title: AutoFixer Agent for Mozark Apps
ideas.why_it_could_win: Covers both halves of the challenge prompt: testing what fails and actively fixing what breaks with evidence of subsequent performance.
